global_style: A minimalist, elegant presentation template featuring a muted Morandi color palette, organic background shapes, and clean overlapping layouts.

identity_anchors: Muted beige background with dusty blue and maroon organic corner blobs.
Wireframe circle accents with diagonal stripe patterns.
Perfect circles used as prominent central framing devices for numbers or titles.
Overlapping rectangular text blocks on image layouts.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
